questions.subject: INTEGRATED_1
questions.learningObjective: Evaluate a nonzero base raised to zero in an engineering brief
questions.stem: An engineer's design brief scales a beam load by (L/L)^0; what is the resulting factor?

options.text: 1 because any nonzero base to the power zero is one
0 because any base to the power zero is zero
options.misconception: confuses zero exponent with zero base

options.text: L because the base cancels before exponentiation
undefined because L could be zero

questions.explanation: Any nonzero quantity raised to zero equals one, so the scaling factor is 1. The tempting idea that the answer is 0 mistakes exponent zero for base zero.
